paragraphs.text: The old shoe factory stood empty for twelve years before the town bought it in 2015. The roof was replaced, but the brick walls and the iron columns were kept, and the machines were given to a museum.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The library opened in 2019 and now has 40,000 books. It also lends musical instruments, a service that no other library in the region offers. Opening hours were extended to nine in the evening after a survey of readers.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: before the town bought it in 2015
items.prompt: The factory was bought by a private company.

explanation.en: The town bought it, not a private company → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Ғимаратты жеке компания емес, қала сатып алған → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Здание купил город, а не частная компания → FALSE.

items.quote: the brick walls and the iron columns were kept
items.prompt: The original walls were removed during the rebuilding.

items.quote: a service that no other library in the region offers
items.prompt: The library is the only one in the region that lends instruments.

explanation.en: “no other library in the region offers” — it is the only one → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «no other library in the region offers» — жалғыз → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «no other library in the region offers» — единственная → TRUE.

items.quote: Opening hours were extended to nine in the evening after a survey of readers
items.prompt: Most readers asked for longer opening hours.

explanation.en: There was a survey, but how many readers asked is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Сауалнама болған, бірақ қанша оқырман ұзақ жұмысты сұрағаны айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Опрос был, но сколько читателей просили дольше работать — не сказано → NOT GIVEN.
